meal.text: A steady routine keeps tummies content.
Two meals a day suit most grown-up cats.
Smaller, more frequent meals suit little and older tummies.
A calm, no-pressure mealtime can help when appetite is low.
Fresh water by the bowl is always a good idea.

play.text: Short, fun bursts match how cats like to play.
Chasing and pouncing satisfy a cat's hunting instinct.
Playing together is lovely bonding time.
Gentle play keeps {name}'s body and mind happy.
Quiet, cosy time is kind on a low-energy day.
